description: Sets a flag, calls a routine, and returns a value offset by 100000 unless the flag was cleared, in which case it returns 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:02A8
name: read_disk_track_dma
description: Sets up disk DMA by writing the sync word, DMA pointer and length registers, enables disk DMA and waits for the disk interrupt request before reading the track data.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:034A
name: retry_disk_dma_read
description: Retries a disk DMA transfer up to five times, writing the DMA length and control registers and waiting on the interrupt request flag on each attempt.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:035C
name: disk_retry_until_counter_limit
description: Returns minus one when a stored value matches the current one. Otherwise it retries a disk DMA transfer up to five times, writing the DMA registers and waiting on the disk flag each time.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:0396
name: repeat_call_count_times
description: Calls a routine repeatedly, counting a 16-bit register down until it reaches minus one.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:03A0
name: call_two_routines_return_d
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:03AC
name: decode_odd_even_bit_longword
description: Decodes a longword stored in odd and even bit layout by separating the alternating bits and recombining them, storing the result when a flag byte is set.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:03D8
name: encode_odd_even_bit_array
description: Loops over a source array, combining the alternating bits of each pair of words into one output longword per entry.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:03F8
name: decode_odd_even_pair_return
description: Loops over a source array, combining the alternating bits of word pairs and returns the last decoded longword.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:0416
name: copy_sector_buffer_to_target
description: When a status word is zero, calls four routines and copies a 1408-long buffer from a fixed offset into the destination.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:17:0444
name: copy_sector_bytes_from_track_buffer
description: When the requested track differs from the stored track, calls routines to load it, then copies a sector of bytes from the track buffer into the destination using a stored length.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:6:0042
name: return_immediately
description: Performs no operations and returns to the caller.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:6:004E
name: return_immediately_two
description: Performs no operations and returns to the caller.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:0:0000
name: run_program_startup
description: Entry routine. Zeroes a block of memory, then uses exec library calls to allocate and free entries and to forbid and permit multitasking around the setup, and closes the libraries it used.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:0:024C
name: record_current_task_context
description: Looks up the current task through exec, stores its fields in globals, and allocates a memory entry for the task context.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:0:02C2
name: cleanup_before_exit
description: Closes open libraries, replies to pending messages and forbids multitasking while releasing resources in reverse order of setup.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:0:0328
name: open_library_or_cleanup
description: Opens a library through a library base call and stores the handle. If the open fails, it runs the cleanup sequence.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:0:0340
name: call_two_table_entries
description: Calls two function pointers read from a table at fixed offsets from a base register, in sequence, then returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:0:0354
name: return_immediately_c
description: Performs no operations and returns to the caller.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0000
name: free_allocation_list
description: Walks a linked list of allocations, calls a free routine on each entry, clears the list head and returns 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0008
name: tokenize_quoted_arguments
description: Scans a text line, skipping spaces, tabs and newlines, and stores each token or quoted string in a fixed array of up to 32 entries.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:001C
name: init_empty_list_head
description: Initialises a list header by storing its own address as the first word, clearing the count and pointing the tail to itself.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:002C
name: return_immediately_d
description: Performs no operations and returns to the caller.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:002E
name: return_immediately_e
description: Performs no operations and returns to the caller.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0030
name: wait_and_reply_port_messages
description: Waits on a message port, retrieves and replies to messages until one matches the expected identifier, then frees the memory it used.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:00D4
name: parse_format_string_arguments
description: Parses a printf-style format string, reading flag characters for space, number sign, plus and minus, then width and type, and converts the matching stack values into text.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:04A6
name: walk_format_string_with_callback
description: Walks a format string, sending plain characters to a callback and parsing each percent conversion through a parsing routine. Doubled percent signs are emitted as a single character.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:04F4
name: find_active_entry_and_act
description: Searches a table of six-byte entries from the end for one whose flag byte is set and whose bit 4 is clear, then calls two routines for it and returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0546
name: forward_to_fixed_jump
description: Consists of a single jump that passes control to a fixed address elsewhere in memory, and is called from one routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0554
name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each character whose class-table entry has bit 2 set to uppercase by subtracting 32, stopping at the terminator.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:059A
name: convert_integer_to_string
description: Repeatedly divides an integer by a fixed-point routine to extract decimal digits as ASCII characters, reverses them into the buffer, null-terminates the string and returns its length.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:05C6
name: convert_octal_to_string
description: Converts an integer into a string by extracting three-bit digits and appending them as characters, then reverses them into the output buffer and returns the length.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0602
name: convert_hex_to_string
description: Converts an integer into a hexadecimal string by extracting four-bit nibbles, mapping each through a character table, reversing them into the output and null-terminating the result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0628
name: parse_decimal_integer
description: Parses a null-terminated string into a signed 16-bit integer, accepting an optional plus or minus sign, accumulating decimal digits, and storing the result at the given location.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0670
name: append_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores a byte at the current end of a buffer and advances the buffer pointer and the count.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0688
name: format_into_buffer_and_count
description: Resets a count, points the output buffer at the supplied location, calls a formatter, null-terminates the buffer and returns the count.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:06C4
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Rounds a requested size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight bytes, searches a free list for a block that fits, and returns the allocated block or minus one when none fits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:07BC
name: copy_bytes_handle_overlap
description: Copies a byte block, copying backward when the destination overlaps the end of the source and forward otherwise.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:080C
name: allocate_sized_record
description: Returns null for a zero size; otherwise it stores the size plus two as a leading word of an allocated record and returns the address after that word.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:085C
name: allocate_and_link_node
description: Allocates memory through the system allocator, stores a size and link fields in the new node, and links it into the list head when the list is empty or appends it to the tail.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:08C8
name: take_block_from_free_list
description: Rounds a requested size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight bytes, searches the free list for a fitting block, splits it and returns the block, or null when none fits.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:09A0
name: set_state_pointer_from_argument
description: If the argument is nonzero, calls a routine and stores the argument minus two as a state pointer.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:09C4
name: call_pairs_until_null
description: Walks a null-terminated argument list, calling a routine with each pair of following values.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:09F8
name: send_port_request_and_wait
description: Builds a request message from a list of argument strings, adds it to a list, sends it through a message port, waits for the reply and frees the memory it used.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0DFC
name: resolve_path_volume_name
description: Scans a path up to a colon or slash, finds the current task, and compares the leading name with the text Workbench.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0F34
name: cleanup_message_port
description: Frees the memory of a message port, clears its signal bit, removes the port from the system and resets the related state fields.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0F74
name: release_library_if_loaded
description: If a library handle is set, calls a library close routine through its base, clears the handle and returns 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0FA0
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values by combining the high and low 16-bit halves, and returns the product in fixed-point form.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0FC0
name: divide_fixed_point_signed
description: Divides two signed 32-bit fixed-point values by taking absolute values, dividing through an unsigned routine and restoring the sign of the result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:0FF2
name: divide_with_quotient_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor in two steps and returns a 64-bit result with the quotient in the high half and the remainder in the low half.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:1084
name: initialize_message_port
description: Allocates memory and a signal, fills in the fields of a message port structure, and registers the port with the system.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:6:1110
name: handle_break_signal_handler
description: Reads the signal set with SetSignal and, when bits 12 or 13 are set and a handler is installed, calls the handler, clears it and returns.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:ultima6:1:0000
name: open_graphics_intuition_libraries
description: Checks available memory, opens the graphics and intuition libraries, closes the Workbench screen and uses the file name BOOK.DAT in the same startup sequence.
